introTitle.text: Section 91.143 Flight limitation in the proximity of space flight operations:

info.text:
• Situations that might results in the issuance of a Section 91.143 TFR.
  • This TFR is issued for Space Flight Operations.

• No person may operate any aircraft of U.S. registry, or pilot any aircraft under the authority of an airman certificate issued by the Federal Aviation Administration, within areas designated in a NOTAM for space flight operation except when authorized by ATC
